مَصْحُوبٌ [Associated with, or accompanied]. ―
-b2- [Hence,] one says [to a person departing], اِمْضِ مَصْحُوبًا (tropical:) Go thou, kept in safety, preserved from harm; and [so] ↓ مُصَاحَبًا : (A, TA:) and [in like manner,] in bidding farewell, مُعَافًا ↓ مُصَاحَبًا (tropical:) [Be thou kept in safety or health, preserved from harm]: and a poet says, “↓ وَصَاحِبِى مِنْ دَوَاعِى السُّوْءِ مُصْطَحَبُ
” (assumed tropical:) [And my companion is preserved, or defended, from the causes of evil]. (TA.) ―
-b3- See also مُصْحَبٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
